descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S15 Unassigned box through chart visits, a Nursing Home round trip and a reload; no Rounding Sheet entry

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 An unassigned box stays on the pad after Quick Dictation is closed and reopened, as the physician's own log. Boxes are never silently dropped. (The UAT says 'stays on the sheet'; … (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 5; TFA-92582 step 5; TFA-92583 AC 4)
  • U6 No auto-assignment anywhere: the app never splits one dictation across patients, never routes by name or room, and never merges boxes. There is no AI routing. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 2; TFA-92583 AC 2)
  • U8 Quick Dictation is Hospital only and is absent in Nursing Home. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 8)
  • T3 Quick Dictation is the pad only: the separate Rounding Sheet view (patients with open tasks, today's assigned compartments, 'Needs patient') is hidden, not deleted, so it can be turned back on. (TFA-92583 AC 5; TFA-92583 AC 4; TFA-92583 AC 1)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Standard fixture ({hospitalPatient}, {snfResident})

When Type 'Bed 9, family updated by phone, no changes.' into a box, close the pad, open the Hospital chart and go back, switch to Nursing Home and open the resident's Encounter tab, switch back to Hospital, reload, reopen the pad

Then No Quick Dictation inside the Nursing Home chart; after the round trip the box is still there and unassigned; the Hospital list has no Rounding Sheet button or 'Needs patient'; the Hospital chart never got the text

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: cp1 /snf/ mustContain {snfResident}, mustNotContain 'quick dictation', 'New compartment', 'family updated by phone' (U8). cp2 /rounding mustContain the box text and 'Assign to patient', mustNotContain 'Re-assign', 'Rounding Sheet', 'Needs patient' (U4, T3). cp3 {hospitalPatient} Encounter mustNotContain 'family updated by phone' (U6)

Where it ran: dev unit U06; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S15 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.

UAT item: TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-04/S15

Unassigned box through chart visits, a Nursing Home round trip and a reload; no Rounding Sheet entry

Tickets: TFA-92582 Quick Dictation (ready for qa); TFA-92583 Rounding Sheet (ready for qa)

Result: Pass from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (generated/tc04s15/verdict.json). Agent: 33 turns, 121 s, $0.22.

Plan: unit U06 (#6, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Unassigned Quick Dictation box. Legacy seed; the Quick Dictation pad belongs to the account, so its compartments and quickDictation:list count would mix with another part's.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #6, U06; checked: yes): Pass — NH chart has no Quick Dictation; reopened pad keeps text + room chip; hospital encounter correct
